letharel_the_silent_border_warden.name: Letharel, the silent border warden
letharel_the_silent_border_warden.description: A watchful border sentinel who studies tracks, wards, and travelers alike, using gestures and carved slate to communicate in near silence.

mirael_a_surface_contact_scout.name: Mirael, a surface-contact scout
mirael_a_surface_contact_scout.description: A quick-eyed scout who uses ravine ledges and signal mirrors to watch for movement beyond the forest fringe.

shuluth_unseen_voice_behind_the_wards.name: Shuluth, unseen voice behind the wards
shuluth_unseen_voice_behind_the_wards.description: An unseen, disembodied presence that speaks through the hall's rotating rings and broken lenses, offering guidance that is always too precise to be trusted.
aliases: Shuluth, unseen voice behind the wards

seryn_vale_keeper_of_the_first_trial.name: Seryn Vale, keeper of the first trial
seryn_vale_keeper_of_the_first_trial.description: A calm, exacting guardian who oversees the entry rites and judges whether visitors are ready for Numillian's psychic tests.
aliases: Seryn Vale, keeper of the first trial

thalanis_secrecy_council_examiner.name: Thalanis, Secrecy Council examiner
thalanis_secrecy_council_examiner.description: A severe evaluator who tests claims, motives, and proof with relentless precision.

ilyra_wardkeeper_adjudicator.name: Ilyra, Wardkeeper adjudicator
ilyra_wardkeeper_adjudicator.description: A stern adjudicator stationed here to observe whether travelers can navigate the trialway without relying on brute force. She records every misstep and every act of restraint.

kobe_a_guarded_resident_tied_to_the_vaul.name: Kobe, a guarded resident tied to the vault
kobe_a_guarded_resident_tied_to_the_vaul.description: A tense resident kept under warded protection, treated as both witness and key to the vault's preservation logic. They know the chamber's routines and are frightened of what the memories might reveal.
aliases: Kobe, a guarded resident tied to the vault

elaris_a_diplomat_of_the_secrecy_council.name: Elaris, a diplomat of the Secrecy Council
elaris_a_diplomat_of_the_secrecy_council.description: A polished envoy with carefully measured speech, sent to assess whether the hidden city can survive exposure without collapsing into panic.
aliases: Elaris, a diplomat of the Secrecy Council

veyrun_a_wardkeeper_captain.name: Veyrun, a Wardkeeper captain
veyrun_a_wardkeeper_captain.description: A disciplined officer overseeing passage through the district's controlled routes. Veyrun is practical, sharp-eyed, and torn between duty to secrecy and concern that the city's barriers are becoming dangerous to maintain.

kobe_endangered_key_witness.name: Kobe, endangered key witness
kobe_endangered_key_witness.description: A guarded resident who has seen enough of the vault crisis to become a target. Kobe is cautious, exhausted, and terrified that speaking plainly will endanger everyone nearby.

shuluth_the_hidden_manipulator.name: Shuluth, the hidden manipulator
shuluth_the_hidden_manipulator.description: An unseen strategist working through intermediaries, records, and quiet pressure. Within the barracks, Shuluth's influence is felt as missing reports, altered orders, and a chilling sense that someone has anticipated every move.

arannis_vault_scholar_and_alarmed_archiv.name: Arannis, vault scholar and alarmed archivist
arannis_vault_scholar_and_alarmed_archiv.description: A frazzled scholar carrying notes, fragments, and urgent warnings about a deeper vault crisis.
aliases: Arannis, vault scholar and alarmed archivist

shuluth_ancient_mind_warder_of_numillian.name: Shuluth, ancient mind-warder of Numillian
shuluth_ancient_mind_warder_of_numillian.description: A terrifyingly old intelligence anchored in the city's ward tradition, present here through layered projections, dreams, or psychic echoes. Its voice is calm, immense, and impossible to fully trust.

kobe_the_life_at_the_center_of_the_crisi.name: Kobe, the life at the center of the crisis
kobe_the_life_at_the_center_of_the_crisi.description: A frightened but resilient resident who has become the focal point of the vault crisis, carrying memories and psychic residue that can stabilize or doom the wards below.
aliases: Kobe, the life at the center of the crisis

letharel_divided_border_warden.name: Letharel, divided border warden
letharel_divided_border_warden.description: The same sentinel as the ruins, now visibly torn between strict secrecy and the need to warn others of what lies deeper in Numillian.

kobe_guarded_resident_tied_to_the_vault.name: Kobe, guarded resident tied to the vault
kobe_guarded_resident_tied_to_the_vault.description: A quiet local whose presence seems important to the wards, kept under watch for their safety and for what they know.
aliases: Kobe, guarded resident tied to the vault
